title: [snmp] Snmp value for cached memory is different from system_info
author: AndriiLozovyi
body:

**Description**
 **snmp/test_snmp_memory.py::test_snmp_memory**  gets failed with message below: 
 ```
> pytest.fail("Snmp memory MIBs: {} differs more than {} %".format(snmp_diff, percent))
E Failed: Snmp memory MIBs: ['ansible_sysCachedMemory'] differs more than 4 %
```

It looks that starting from sonic image `SONiC.master.137279-dirty-20220820.094848` something changed in output of snmp for CachedMemory, and now output of snmp and info from system have a difference about 6.7-7 %. On previous sonic image `SONiC.master.135201-dirty-20220815.112418` output of snmp for cached memory was in touch with system_info from DUT. 

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy sonic image `SONiC.master.137279-dirty-20220820.094848`
2. Run cmd from sonic-mgmt `snmpwalk -v 2c -c public <DUT_IP> 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.15.0`
3. Check cached memory value on device `cat /proc/meminfo | grep Cached`

**Describe the results you received:**
On `SONiC.master.137279-dirty-20220820.094848`:

```
iso.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.15.0 = INTEGER: 1045492
Cached:           972064 kB

>>> CALC_DIFF = lambda snmp, sys_data: float(abs(snmp - int(sys_data)) * 100) / float(snmp)
>>> CALC_DIFF(1045492, 972064)
7.023296208866256
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
On `SONiC.master.135201-dirty-20220815.112418`:

```
iso.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.15.0 = INTEGER: 965504
Cached:           965504 kB
>>> CALC_DIFF(965504, 965504)
0.0
```

**Additional information you deem important:**

comments.author: AndriiLozovyi
comments.body:
If this change in output of snmp for cached memory is okay and acceptable, then the fix would probably be to increase the percentage, although not sure that 8% will be enough, because I spotted even higher difference. 

```
Cached:          2480620 kB
iso.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.15.0 = INTEGER: 2800252
>>> CALC_DIFF(2800252, 2480620)
11.414401275313793
```

Strange that only snmp output for cached memory seems to have such difference between these two sonic images: 
`SONiC.master.135201-dirty-20220815.112418`
```
# sysTotalFreeMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(12482868, 12483008)
0.001121537133934285

# sysTotalBuffMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(43428, 43428)
0.0

# sysCachedMemory 
>>> CALC_DIFF(965504, 965504)
0.0

# sysTotalSharedMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(24104, 24104)
0.0
```

`SONiC.master.137279-dirty-20220820.094848`
```
# sysTotalFreeMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(12520324, 12520340)
0.00012779222007353803

# sysTotalBuffMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(33048, 33048)
0.0 

# sysCachedMemory 
>>> CALC_DIFF(1045492, 972064)
7.023296208866256

# sysTotalSharedMemory
>>> CALC_DIFF(36896, 36896)
0.0 
```

Summary:  `snmp/test_snmp_memory.py::test_snmp_memory` gets failed with message below:
```
> pytest.fail("Snmp memory MIBs: {} differs more than {} %".format(snmp_diff, percent))
E Failed: Snmp memory MIBs: ['ansible_sysCachedMemory'] differs more than 4 %
```
Starting from `SONiC.master.137279-dirty-20220820.094848` snmp value for cached memory differ from value collected from DUT.
It seems that difference is caused by `snmpd` memory calculation approach - [12192](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12192#issuecomment-1276413286)
This PR should align test case.
